card.name: Accusatory words in political polemic
card.fires_on: Loaded or accusatory words in heated opinion writing, such as lying, nonsense, or exploit, aimed at an opposing political or ideological group. Common in rants about government, abortion, or immigration.

modes.label: Accusing opponents
modes.description: Words that charge opponents with deceit or bad faith, such as lying or exploit.
modes.example: Planned Parenthood says that personhood would outlaw contraceptives, they are either<< lying>> now, or they were lying

modes.label: Rhetorical blame or group references
modes.description: Nouns or pronouns that name a blamed group or rally a side, such as industry, Chinese, Our, or We.
modes.example: the abortion<< industry>> today even fears the term mother, and

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese characters for arguing, insulting, and blasphemy, which suggests a push toward accusatory or insulting language.
